comando.description: The shell command, interpreted by `sh -c` INSIDE the container — same convention as the terminal action run outside one.

cwd.description: Working directory INSIDE the container. Already translated from the host path by the engine (RN-492) — this DTO doesn't repeat that translation. Omitted runs at `/work`, the project root. The broker re-validates it is inside `/work` and refuses (`DiretorioForaDoEscopoError`) otherwise.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Omitted uses the broker default.
